blocks.text: Lekin computing ke nuqsanat (drawbacks) bhi hain. Ek bari fikr digital divide hai: aabadi ke ek bare hisse ko jadeed computing technology tak rasai nahi. Pakistan mein shehri aur dehi (urban-rural) farq wazeh hai: dehi ilaqon mein qabil-e-aitbaar internet aur computing devices kam hain, jis se taleem aur rozgar ke mauqe barabar nahi rehte. Doosra manfi asar misinformation (ghalat maloomat) aur fake news (jhooti khabron) ka phailna hai, jo social unrest (samaji be-chaini) paida kar sakta hai.

Misal: COVID-19 ki waba ke dauran virus aur vaccines ke bare mein ghalat maloomat social media par tezi se phaili, aur logon mein uljhan aur khauf paida hua. Is se pata chalta hai ke digital literacy zaroori hai, ta ke log online milne wali maloomat ko soch samajh kar (critically) parakh sakein.

Privacy ki fikr bhi ek bara masla hai, kyunke computing systems ke barhte istemal se bohat sara personal data jama aur store ho raha hai. Munasib regulations (qawaid aur qanoon) na hon to is data ka ghalat istemal ho sakta hai, aur privacy aur security toot (breach ho) sakti hai. Pakistan mein National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) se shehriyon ke data leak hone jaise waqiat batate hain ke data ki hifazat ke mazboot intezamat kitne zaroori hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Computing technology ki wajah se “Internet in a Box” projects mumkin hue hain jo offline (baghair internet) taleemi mawad dete hain. Pakistan mein aise iqdamat ne un door daraz ilaqon tak digital taleem pohanchai hai jahan internet nahi, aur yeh dikhaya hai ke technology pichhre ilaqon mein taleemi faasla kam kar sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Aam log ghalat maloomat ka nuqsan kaise kam kar sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Kisi baat ko maanne ya share karne se pehle use qabil-e-aitbaar sources se check karein (critical thinking aur digital literacy), aur ghair tasdeeq shuda messages aage forward na karein.

items: Manfi asar: digital divide (shehri-dehi farq), misinformation aur fake news (COVID-19), privacy ke khatre (NADRA data leak).
“Internet in a Box”: baghair internet ke ilaqon mein offline digital taleem.
